The current management MCP server exposes **15 tools**.
Exactly **5** of those operations also have an
implemented self-hosted HTTP route. An MCP-only tool must not be called through an
invented HTTP path.

> `env:ro` and `env:rw` are contract metadata, not enforced scoped-key permissions.
> F4 owns shared scope enforcement and its security evidence.

| [`create_environment`](#create_environment) | mutation | never | none | MCP only |
| [`list_environments`](#list_environments) | read | safe | none | MCP only |
| [`delete_environment`](#delete_environment) | destructive | idempotent | none | `DELETE /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}` |
| [`configure_environment`](#configure_environment) | mutation | idempotent | none | `PUT /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}` |
| [`seed_identities`](#seed_identities) | mutation | never | request redact | `POST /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}/identities:seed` |
| [`create_application`](#create_application) | mutation | never | request redact; response display-once | `POST /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}/applications` |
| [`mint_token`](#mint_token) | mutation | never | response redact | MCP only |
| [`run_provisioning_cycle`](#run_provisioning_cycle) | outbound | never | request redact | MCP only |
| [`set_scenario`](#set_scenario) | mutation | idempotent | none | MCP only |
| [`clear_scenario`](#clear_scenario) | mutation | idempotent | none | MCP only |
| [`get_request_log`](#get_request_log) | read | safe | response redact | MCP only |
| [`assert_requests`](#assert_requests) | read | safe | none | MCP only |
| [`simulate_lifecycle`](#simulate_lifecycle) | destructive | never | none | MCP only |
| [`get_wellknown_urls`](#get_wellknown_urls) | read | safe | none | `GET /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}/well-known` |
| [`set_current_environment`](#set_current_environment) | mutation | idempotent | none | MCP only |

## Transport and result contract

- Transport: Streamable HTTP at `/mcp`.
- Tested protocol revision: `2025-11-25`.
- Standalone GET stream: unsupported; `GET /mcp` returns `405`.
- Successful tools return text content plus structured content shaped as
  `{ data, meta: { requestId } }`.
- Handler failures return an MCP error result containing an RFC 7807 problem.
- SDK input-schema failures happen before handler entry and use the SDK validation
  error shape.
- Saved automation should pass an explicit `environmentId`; the current-environment
  cursor is transport-session-local.

### `create_environment`

**Create mock identity environment.** Creates an Entra ID or Okta environment and selects it as this session's current environment.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `mutation`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: none
- HTTP: MCP only
- MCP annotations: read-only `false`, destructive `false`, idempotent `false`, open-world `false`

### `seed_identities`

**Seed users and groups.** Creates users and groups in an environment. MCP may use the session cursor; HTTP always requires an explicit environment.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `mutation`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: request redact
- HTTP: `POST /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}/identities:seed`

### `create_application`

**Create application registration.** Registers an OAuth/OIDC client in an explicit or session-selected environment.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `mutation`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: request redact; response display-once
- HTTP: `POST /__mockos/v1/environments/{environmentId}/applications`
- MCP annotations: read-only `false`, destructive `false`, idempotent `false`, open-world `false`

<summary>Input JSON Schema</summary>


<a id="mint_token"></a>

### `mint_token`

**Mint identity token.** Mints a token, optionally with a deterministic broken-token variant, in the current or named environment.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `mutation`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: response redact
- HTTP: MCP only
- MCP annotations: read-only `false`, destructive `false`, idempotent `false`, open-world `false`

<a id="run_provisioning_cycle"></a>

### `run_provisioning_cycle`

**Run outbound provisioning cycle.** Starts a deterministic Entra or Okta-shaped SCIM provisioning cycle against a validated test target.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `outbound`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: request redact
- HTTP: MCP only
- MCP annotations: read-only `false`, destructive `true`, idempotent `false`, open-world `true`

<a id="simulate_lifecycle"></a>

### `simulate_lifecycle`

**Simulate provider lifecycle transition.** Applies an Entra or Okta user lifecycle action, including token revocation, in the current or named environment.

- Scope metadata: `env:rw`
- Effect: `destructive`
- Retry policy: `never`
- Secret handling: none
- HTTP: MCP only
- MCP annotations: read-only `false`, destructive `true`, idempotent `false`, open-world `false`

<details>
<summary>Input JSON Schema</summary>

```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "action": {
      "enum": [
        "activate",
        "disable",
        "reactivate",
        "suspend",
        "unsuspend",
        "deprovision",
        "delete"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "environmentId": {
      "maxLength": 64,
      "minLength": 8,
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "userId": {
      "maxLength": 128,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "userId",
    "action"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

## Unavailable MCP surfaces

- Environment-hosted mock MCP servers are planned for F1 and do not exist in this
  source.
- Mock OpenAI and Anthropic APIs are planned for F2 and do not exist in this source.
- Code Mode `search` and `execute` are planned for F6 and remain disabled.

Use [implementation status](../IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md) for evidence and the
[interface model](../concepts/interface-model.md) for the distinction between
management MCP and future mock MCP workloads.
